score_definitions.lc_plus_log_prior_margin: margin computed from z + log(pi), matching LogitCompensatedCE training convention
score_definitions.inverse_prior_margin: margin computed from z - log(pi), diagnostic hypothesis only
score_definitions.class_normalized_raw_margin: (raw_margin - observed-class mean) / (observed-class std + 1e-8); computed without clean/noisy status

guardrails: No training, optimizer, scheduler, or BatchNorm update was performed.
No official TEST data was instantiated or read.
Clean labels and the flip mask were used only after inference for offline evaluation.
Group membership is based on observed labels, not original clean source labels.
No threshold was selected using clean/noisy truth.
